_readme: Runtime configuration for ANF3 Laboratory Records.
Edit with Notepad, save, refresh the browser. No rebuild, no Node, no pnpm.
This file sits beside START-ANF3.bat and is NOT touched by a rebuild.
Paste the Web App URL ending in /exec for each domain. A value left empty
falls back to whatever was compiled in from .env.production, so filling in
one line changes only that domain.
PUBLIC READ endpoints only. Never put ANF3_SYNC_TOKEN here.
